svg.title: KnobShift mixing three songs, each with its own transition
svg.desc: Two decks play a set of four songs. Each mix is planned for its pair of songs. In the first, the tempos are close, so the beats lock and the old voice slows down like tape. In the second, the tempos are far apart, so each song keeps its speed and the verse echoes out on the beat. In the third, KnobMix Now waits for the next phrase, then the old song sinks under an underwater filter. Every effect rises until the old verse ends and falls away by the handoff, pumping on the beat, while the new song's beats come in under the old voice and its own voice lands through a short reverb.

g.text: Every pair of songs gets its own mix.
